answer: Copying the same citations across 25 aliases as a result pays the reading cost 25 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the sable check immediately, the dawn audit keeps the resolved set and the basalt replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
